inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada has a duty to maintain an orderly immigration system and protect its citizens; enforcing rules is not a failure simply because critics call it “securitizing” migration. Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026, and the real test is whether the rules are applied fairly and consistently—not whether the state abandons its authority at the border. People fleeing danger deserve humane treatment, including Nigerians, but compassion also requires clear standards and a system the public can trust. Making every limit sound cruel weakens the case for responsible protection.
